name: briefing
description: Create end-to-end encrypted Briefing video rooms and invite people, right from the conversation.
long_description:
Briefing is a secure video chat from Germany: end-to-end encrypted, no accounts, no tracking. This extension lets Claude create Briefing rooms on your computer and put the invitation link into emails, calendar events or messages.

The room is made locally - nothing is registered anywhere. The participant link (the one meant for invitations) goes to Claude, unless you switch that off; the moderator link never does: you join as moderator through your own browser. Works with the official instance brie.fi and with your own Briefing server.

tools.name: create_room
tools.description: Create a new end-to-end encrypted video or chat room

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List the rooms made on this computer

tools.name: get_room_link
tools.description: The participant link of a room, for invitations

tools.name: open_room
tools.description: Join a room in your browser, as moderator or participant

tools.name: copy_room_link
tools.description: Put a room link on the clipboard without showing it

tools.name: forget_room
tools.description: Remove a room from this computer's list

instance.title: Briefing server
instance.description: Address of the Briefing instance, e.g. your own server. Leave empty for the official one, https://brie.fi/ng/.

share_links.title: Let Claude see the participant link
share_links.description: On: Claude can put the link into emails and calendar events. Off: links only go to your clipboard and your browser. The moderator link never goes to Claude.
